title: Walk a folder or drive into the store without following links
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: 1. Nested tree with paths over 260 characters: every file and folder in the store once per name under its real parent, compared with an independent recursive listing, in a non-elevated process: partial

4. Link only when the reparse attribute is set and the tag has the surrogate bit; cloud tags 0x9000201A, 0x9000401A, 0x9000601A, 0x9000E01A and reparse with tag 0 are descended; junction and symlink are not: partial
5. A folder that cannot be opened or listed is recorded with path and error code and the scan continues; errors 5, 363 and 1920 are all handled this way: partial
6. A scan of a drive's root records the used space the volume reports alongside the tree; compared with Get-Volume Size minus SizeRemaining: partial

long-path-testhost-vs-published-exe: needs first: If any App code path opens paths longer than 260 chars without the \\?\ prefix, App needs an app.manifest with longPathAware=true (wired via ApplicationManifest in FsAnalyser.App.csproj)…

Where the used-space figure lives. This design puts a Task<long?> on ScanStore, read by the App. The alternatives are a plain nullable on ScanResult (the read then has to be joined or polled at the end, which risks the stall) or leaving it in the App and rewording criterion 6 (which the survey said 'someone should decide'). A person may reasonably prefer the last; the design owns the agreed wording, so it moves the read.

VolumeSpace as its own file with an injectable reader, versus a private method in Scanner. The separate file lets the rule 'may not name ScanStore' have a file to point at. It is boundary placement, and neither answer changes a contract.
The 64 MiB slack on the Get-Volume bracket. It is inherited from the spike's method, and a tighter or looser bound is a judgement about how noisy this machine's drive is.
Classification rows for 363/1920 extend SynchronousIoCancelTests, as beside the existing 0/5/995 test, rather than a new ClassifyReadErrorTests file.
tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/TokenElevation.cs (design component): replaced by Environment.IsPrivilegedProcess per the accepted m4.

M1's suggested 'settle it for real' StallRig private-bytes measurement against a drive-root scan: StallRig serves a UNC share with no drive letter, and mapping one to a letter outside the rig breaks the SMB-mapping rule. The WeakReference test stands in for it.

eng/rules-harness/plants.json has no plant rows for the four new twinned entries (SL-040 added F17-F19 for its rule). They need a harness run with the TAAD engine (--engine-root), because plant outcomes must come from recorded runs. It was not run here.

tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 hard-codes 'AGREE 8 facts <- 11 twinned entries, 23 patterns; 15 settled'. That was already stale before this slice (SL-039 and SL-042 raised settled to 21); it is now 11/15/27/24. C-001, C-003, C-004 and C-005 of that script will fail until someone refreshes the numbers.

DFS tension (m1): criterion 4 descends DFS folders, and through a namespace share that follows a referral into another server, where FileId dedup has no volume part. It is accepted and documented but not measured. A person may want to decide whether DFS stays descended.
SUBST letters and letters mapped to share subfolders pass IsDriveRoot and get the host volume's figure (m3, deferred). V-001 relies on exactly that.

The scanner's own root open, and SizeProbe, run without SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS. A drive-root scan of an empty removable drive could still raise the 'insert a disk' box from the scan thread. This predates the slice (m2's decision puts it out of scope).
Stopped whole-drive endings now carry the volume line with 'of it is not in this partial scan' wording. It is the first time that text is live, and a person may want to look at it.
